nature: Fail-closed fix for CoinsDB deserialize / Coin integrity (Scheme A). Does not modify Consensus Kernel, Transaction Kernel, Ledger, genesis, issuance, RES, draw, PoW, ASERT, consensus parameters, P2P rules, wallet consensus, or Coq proofs.

formal_layers.C_database_serialization: locked by golden vectors + standalone codec; disk Coin is leaf + CRC32C_RGCI; MuHash leaves omit checksum (STATE_HASH v4)
formal_layers.E_database_implementation_correctness: inherited Bitcoin Core LevelDB wrapper; value-corruption fail-closed TRUE

databases.name: CoinsDB / chainstate/
databases.notes: Persistence of the UTXO set. Serialization is not a second kernel. Corrupt values abort. CoinDiskFormatter CRC-32C. Wipe / -reindex; no in-place migration.

databases.name: block index / blocks/index/
databases.notes: GetValue failure is fail-closed. Truncated pre-H-1 records throw. m_paid_winner_txid is re-checked by ValidatePaidWinnerRecord.

databases.name: block storage blk*.dat + rev*.dat
databases.notes: Authoritative block and undo bytes. chainstate is reconstructed from these.

databases.name: wallet / rigor-wallet.sqlite
databases.notes: Wallet DB cannot accept or reject blocks. Berkeley DB wallets are rejected.

databases.name: pool / explorer SQL
databases.notes: Not on the node accept/reject path.

findings.title: CDBWrapper::Read maps deserialize failure to missing coin
findings.effect: Corrupted Coin value → GetCoin false → AccessCoin empty → CheckTxInputs TX_CONSENSUS bad-txns-inputs-missingorspent
findings.can_accept_invalid_block: No. Read throws; ErrorCatcher abort(). HaveCoin/Exists is key presence only.
findings.remediation: Fixed: existing-key deserialize failure throws DESERIALIZATION_FAILURE / DATABASE_CORRUPTION. Missing key still returns false.

findings.title: Height and coinbase flag are trusted from CoinsDB with no checksum
findings.production: Coin::Unserialize reads VARINT code into nHeight/fCoinBase
findings.effect: A flipped coinbase bit or reduced height fails CoinIntegrityChecksum and aborts (cannot skip maturity).
findings.remediation: Fixed Scheme A: CRC-32C Castagnoli over nHeight, fCoinBase, nValue, scriptPubKey in CoinDiskFormatter. Mismatch is DATABASE_CORRUPTION. Wipe / -reindex; no format marker.

findings.title: ScriptCompression oversized records are rewritten to RIGOR_MARKER_RETURN
findings.effect: nSize > MAX_SCRIPT_SIZE throws DATABASE_CORRUPTION. No rewrite to RIGOR_MARKER_RETURN.

findings.title: Bitcoin compressed-script types on the Coin path
findings.effect: Coin path is VARINT(len)||bytes. Types 4/5 no longer exist on disk Coin records.

findings.title: AddCoins encodes UTXO-membership for convergence in the cache layer
findings.production: coins.cpp AddCoin/AddCoins and validation DisconnectBlock use EntersUtxoSet
findings.effect: Second copy of 'convergence is not a UTXO'. Not a second accept/reject kernel. DisconnectBlock must stay symmetric.

findings.title: ApplyTxInUndo copies sibling metadata when undo height is 0
findings.effect: Height-0 non-coinbase undo throws. DisconnectBlock AbortNode. No sibling copy. Genesis coinbase undos (height 0 + coinbase) keep stored metadata.

findings.title: CCoinsViewCache::Cursor skips GetValue failures
findings.effect: A corrupt record disappears from RPC/snapshot materialization without aborting.

findings.title: DisconnectBlock special-cased Bitcoin BIP30 exception heights
findings.production: validation.cpp ConnectBlock always rejects duplicate outpoints
findings.effect: BIP30 exception helpers removed. Duplicate outpoints are consensus-invalid.

findings.title: CCoinsViewDB::HaveCoin uses Exists without deserializing the value
findings.effect: A corrupt value looks present to direct DB HaveCoin. ConnectBlock cache HaveCoin uses FetchCoin/GetCoin and aborts.

findings.title: ErrorCatcher does not wrap ReplayBlocks
findings.effect: Crash recovery deserialize throws rather than ErrorCatcher abort. Not mapped to TX_CONSENSUS.

findings.title: CRC-32C is not a MAC
findings.effect: Well-formed tampering with a recomputed trailer is trusted infrastructure, not random-corruption fail-closed.

findings.title: Audit gate replica is not production libbitcoin_common
findings.production: tools/database_state_codec.py and standalone test; coins_tests.cpp is the production lock
findings.effect: Coverage gap if replica drifts. Lint locks production fail-closed sites.

findings.title: Production -reindex not executed
findings.effect: REBUILD_EQUIVALENCE remains PARTIAL. CONSENSUS_STATE_EQUIVALENCE is harness-TRUE.

findings.title: Fuzz is smoke, not a campaign
findings.effect: CRASH_FOUND=NO is limited to fuzz/database/run_smoke.sh plus overlay ops.

error_class_matrix.CONSENSUS_INVALID: Kernel / ConnectBlock / CheckTxInputs reject of a well-read state
error_class_matrix.NODE_RECOVERY_REQUIRED: ReplayBlocks unknown heads; NeedsUpgrade; reindex flags
error_class_matrix.CORRUPTED_PERSISTENT_STATE: Malformed value or checksum mismatch → abort / DISCONNECT_FAILED

canonical_coin.layout: leaf VARINT((coinbase?1:0)|(height<<1)) || VARINT(CompressAmount) || VARINT(scriptLen) || script; disk/undo adds CRC32C_RGCI

rigor_required_retests: Coin ser/deser with witness v0 ORU, witness v1 RES, RES mint, convergence skip
undo of RES mint / RES transfer / convergence-not-in-UTXO
cache vs restart vs reindex consensus-state on a RIGOR golden chain
corruption of height / coinbase / asset script must abort (not CONSENSUS_INVALID)
